description: What a US-listed company's executives, directors and 10% owners bought and sold, from their Form 4 filings: who (name and role, as filed), when, what kind of trade (open-market buy or sale, option exercise, grant, shares withheld for tax, gift), shares, price, value, holdings after, and whether a sale was under a pre-set 10b5-1 plan. Sums open-market buys and sales. Each filing links to the SEC. Use for 'are insiders selling X?', 'did the CEO buy?'.

company.description: Ticker (AAPL), company name, or SEC CIK

limit.description: Recent Form 4 filings to read, default 10, max 20

name: insider_trades
title: Insider trades (SEC Form 4)
